sources.role: native SDL input event vocabulary, configuration, savestate and Kickstart directory implementation
native controller-profile grammar, device-name normalization and duplicate-name matching
official options and input mapping names

paths.path: ~/.config/fs-uae/ (FS-UAE user config directory); per-game configurations are *.fs-uae option files
paths.naming: INI-style option lines; controller bindings use joystick_<port>_<button/axis> = action_* (for example joystick_0_button_10 = action_save_state_9)
evidence: source:od-fs/libfsemu path service and fsuae config sources @f362278

paths.path: The same FS-UAE option/config files and Controllers data directory
paths.naming: joystick_<port>_<button|axis> = action_<name>; shipped controller profiles are named <controller>.conf and SDL mappings are in Data/Devs/Controllers/gamecontrollerdb.txt

paths.path: Save data is written by the emulated Amiga into mounted floppy/hard-disk media; FS-UAE does not invent a universal sidecar save extension
paths.naming: In-image files retain the Amiga application's filename; media remains the authoritative save container

paths.path: ~/FS-UAE/Save States/ under the FS-UAE base directory (configurable with save_states_dir)
paths.naming: Slot files use the configured save-state filename/mask and the .uss state format; actions are action_save_state_1 through action_save_state_9
evidence: source:fsuae savestate.cpp and od-fs path service @f362278

paths.naming: Kickstart ROMs use FS-UAE's recognized Kickstart names such as kick*.rom; no canonical checksum is asserted here because regional/revision images vary and the official docs do not provide one
